topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: I got a call from a worried man, said he found his old lady's bucket list scribbled in a battered notebook. Sun was setting, and the city lights were just starting to flicker on, casting long, uncertain shadows. He handed me the notebook, his hands trembling like a leaf in the wind. I flipped through the pages, each entry a whisper of dreams he never knew she had. I looked him square in the eye and told him, "Sometimes, the person you think you know best is the one full of surprises." He swallowed hard, but there was a glint in his eye, like he finally understood there was more to the woman he loved than just the quiet life they shared. I took the case, told him I'd get to the bottom of it. He nodded, a bit of color coming back to his cheeks. I could handle this, no problem.
